summary: This thesis proposes HPC-AutoResearch, an autonomous research system adapted from AI Scientist v2 for high-performance computing environments. A Split-Phase execution model divides the research process into five stages (planning, environment setup, coding, compilation, execution), while a MemGPT-style three-layer hierarchical memory (Core/Recall/Archival) retains critical knowledge under context-length constraints. The system also integrates Singularity container-based execution isolation and Best-First tree search for efficient exploration of the implementation space. Comparative experiments on the Himeno Benchmark against Claude Code, Codex, and Gemini CLI showed that the proposed method achieved the highest scores across all seven LLM review criteria (3/4 each), earning an Overall 7/10 with an Accept verdict.
